strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Lady Janera... What shall we do now?
Do not panic, Warukimedes.
To think the Earthlings would possess such power...
But we cannot simply sit idle like this.
I know. But... we cannot contact Planet Campbell.
For now, we have no choice but to wait.
What about using those fellows?
...There has been no contact since Demon Mask Castle...
They were merely Oleana's pawns on Earth. They cannot be relied upon.
Didn't Demon Mask Castle fail because you relied on them, brother?
Silence! ...But being unable to contact the homeworld is worrying.
Could it be...
Hold your tongue! That could never happen!
It's here! There's no doubt!
Oh! There they are, there they are!
Wh-What, Hyoma Aoi?!
How did you find this place?!
Just like ol' Deus said.
Deus... Did you say Deus?!
Give it up already!
Deus... Lady Janera, could it be...!
That's right, the envoy from Planet Campbell!
Planet Campbell has called off its plan to invade Earth!
Wh... Nonsense! I won't fall for such a bluff!
Muhahaha, who cares! Whatever's become of Planet Campbell...
I'll still settle things with you! Face me, Hyoma Aoi!
Bring it on! Dangel!
Let's settle this!
LEEEET'S! COOOMBIIIINE!
All right, all units, launch!
Well, what'll it be?! Janera!
...So there is no longer anywhere for us to return...
Lady Janera... What they said... no place to return... surely not...
It adds up... The peace faction, long opposed to us reformists,
on Planet Campbell has retaken the government.
L-Lady Janera... What on earth do you intend to do...?
...It is no matter.
What do you mean?
We need only bring this Earth under our rule!
Stop this pointless resistance.
Think about it. Is that even possible with the forces you have left?
That's right. We'll take care of you all at once...!
Wait, Tetsuya! ...Empress Janera, go wherever you please.
What...?!
Hey, hey, hold on! We've got these guys cornered!
Even if we let them go here, if they cause trouble somewhere else...
...I believe I know the sorrow of those who've lost their home.
Brother...
But still...
Hyoma?!
What are you playing at?! Hyoma Aoi!
We've been fighting to protect Earth. Get outta here!
But if you come at us, we won't hold back!
Heh... Hahahahahahahaha!
...You underestimate me, the Empress Janera...!
Hyoma Aoi! Do you think I would shamefully flee home?! Warukimedes!
Yes! ...If we defeat you here...
Earth's military won't have its forces in order! We... we still have a chance!
You bastards... Ignoring how Daisuke and Aoi feel...!
Foolish...
If that's your answer...!
I told you we won't hold back if you come at us! JANERAAA!
Heheheh... To think that I... the great Janera...
would die in a place like this...
You idiot... You had to know you couldn't win...!
Heheheh... Hyoma... Aoi. If you and I were in each other's place...
would you say... you'd flee home?
That's...
...We'd fight... to the end.
Everyone... thinks the same... Heheheh... And that is why...
...strife will never vanish from this universe.
You're so selfish! You're the ones who attacked us!
Yeah, that's right!
...It does not change... the universe... Only those... Oleana worked with...
Heh... Heheheheheh... Not yet...! Combattler V!!
At the very least, you're coming with me!
What?! She's comin', Hyoma!!
A suicide attack...?! Hyoma!
...I accept, Janera! Combattler doesn't run or hide!
Nailed it... Super Electromagnetic Spin...!
That's... the end.
What a... sad person.
We couldn't save her...
She couldn't become... like Daisuke and Maria.
...Tch, this doesn't feel good... even though we won!
And then a riddle at the end. What was that all about?
What did she mean, the universe doesn't change?
But now... it's over.
The problem ain't solved. It starts now.
...Yes. Don't neglect to check our remaining forces!
Ruri, I'm counting on you.
Roger.
Kyosuke? What's wrong?
The Einst... changing... the universe?
Excellen, you... know something, don't you?
...Sorry, Kyosuke. I don't know...
The land of beginnings, various powers, and the time has come...
That's what you said while they were controlling you.
Sorry, I'm sorry, Kyosuke... I can't remember...
Don't push her too hard... Excellen really doesn't seem to remember...
Excellen...
Hm!?
An enemy attack?! Shaff, are they Campbellian survivors?!
Princess, this ID code is...!
Sheesh, these Campbellians are a sorry bunch!
They got wiped out real quick, Big Sis Diondra.
Don't call me Big Sis!
...Heh, I never expected anything from a dying army anyway.
That weird Kansai accent... It's the Gyandlar's grunts!
Hey! Who're you callin' grunts?!
We're the Gyandlar's dreaded Demon Commander unit, Devil Saturn 6!
If you're gonna talk Kansai, you gotta play the fool more or it ain't funny...
Why make 'em any dumber?! Plus, there's a big shot with them.
Diondra, you...
Easy, Rom. That's what they want. You know how dirty they play.
Heheheh... Dirty? Call it strategy.
Hiding 'cause you were scared, right? Always your specialty.
What?! Keep runnin' your mouth and you'll be sorry!
Whatever, just come at us! We're angry, you know!
Well said! Get 'em...
Wait, Devil Saturn. You've walked right into the enemy's trap.
...You... Gardy.
Hm... This man... He's good...!
Mm... Do not let your guard down, Domon!
Oh? You seem to have grown since last we fought,
Londo Bell.
Thanks to you guys.
We're ready to smash creeps like you, one after another.
That's right. Bring it on!
Back-to-back battles... Should we pull back for now?
No... We should fight this out to the end, Captain.
Everyone's fighting spirit is high... We should push straight through.
That's our old man Hazuki. ...That's what I'm talkin' about!
Geez, look who's talking. Even if Captain Bright ordered a retreat,
you wouldn't listen anyway.
Captain Misumaru, are we all right?
Everyone's raring to go! In that case, let's do it!
It can't be helped, I suppose.
Though spending so much at once is hardly economical...
It's settled. ...We can't afford to lose time in a place like this.
You've got guts... I'll make this place your grave!
Get them! Devil Saturn 6!
Gadessa!
Come on...!
Diondra.
Hm? What is it, Gardy?
Leave this to me.
What? What do you mean? Don't tell me you want the credit...
You can have that. ...That man, Rom Stol...
I've long been interested in him. Do as you like with the Star of La Mu.
I see. So we carried the treasure
right up into space, huh?
But... that was the right call. As long as we have it...
we won't hand it over so easily!
Mr. Gardy! Let's do this, then!
He is all that interests me. Do as you please with the rest.
Heheheh...
Be careful, everyone. That man... is not all talk.
Brother...
He's asking for you, Rom.
...Fine by me! Gardy...!
Then I'll just sit back and enjoy the show!
Devil Saturn 6, you go after that battleship!
If you can get your hands on the Star of La Mu...
your Commander Ranking will triple!
Gadessa! Heheh, let's do this!
Looks like they're after the battleships.
Huh? Whaaaat?!
Annoying! If you're coming, then come!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Mmgh?! To think they've grown this strong...!
Well done, Earthlings...! And you too, Rom Stol.
It's decided...!
It's over.
Now I'll end this...!
We'll take down this Gyandlar leader!
Prepare yourself!!
Wait! You sure?! That's your brother! You'd kill your brother?!
Wh-What?!
This Gardy is your brother!
My brother...?
That's right! You seem to believe your brother is dead, Rom!
Us... brothers...
It can't be... Brother...?
Unbelievable!
Now, Gardy! Finish him off!
He and I... brothers...!
Knock it off! Making stuff up like that...!
If you're going to lie, at least make it a better one...!
...Not necessarily.
Hayato? Come on, there's no way...
...Too outlandish for a mere smear. Either it's pure nonsense...
You mean it's true?!
...It backfired...?! We're pulling out!
Ah! They're running away?!
Damn it! They caught us off guard?!
Hey, Rom! Are we just gonna let them get away?!
Brother Rom! Let's go after them!
Yes, I know. But...
Go, Rom.
Banjo...
...Even if that claim that Gardy is your brother
is just an excuse for them to escape...
We must make certain.
...Leaving such a worry unresolved is bad for one's peace of mind.
Brother.
We'll head that way too!
...In turn, we'll be relying on your strength
to track down the Gyandlar's headquarters...!
Heh, save some for us, okay?
Thank you, everyone... I'll be back, I promise.
May the Kenrou guide Londo Bell...!
Rom's way too formal. He doesn't have to carry it all alone.
You said it. ...We're going too, Drill, Jim!
Ah, wait for me!
Geez, hurry up or we'll leave you behind, Jim!
I too shall lend my blade!
We're going too, Colon!
Okay, Sis.
JEEEEET!
Is this all right... Captain Bright?
Yes... They'll be back, without fail.
Just as they always have.
All enemies in this area have been wiped out.
...So now there are no more Campbellians targeting Earth.
...Not a very satisfying fight, though. And Rom and the others left, too.
True... That Gardy guy, their officer, has me worried too.
That guy, Rom's brother... It's a little hard to believe.
We've narrowed down the enemy groups still left...
but splitting up our forces like this...
Can't be helped. Things don't always go the way you want.
Ain't that the truth. Well, we handled the Campbellians, so let's call it good.
Cheer up, Hyoma.
I know. ...I know...
First Garuda, now Janera... What was it all about...
And how are the Campbellians connected to the Einst series?
They didn't show up this time... So they weren't allies.
Our fight with them ended before we figured out the connection...
I do think they're deeply connected to Earth, but...
Aw, come on... Even they wanna take a stroll now and then.
They even show up in Byston Well, after all.
The truth is still a total mystery...
Excellen... Do you know anything?
...The only ones with a direct connection...
were the Campbellians who came to Earth first...
You know that?!
What kind of connection?!
...I'm sorry... That's all I...
Oleana, the Campbellian vanguard, came to Earth... in the ancient past.
That's probably where Raideen's connection lies, too.
Right. And the Gaizok were robots made by the Gaizok people,
who died out long ago, right?
The ancient past... That's the keyword...
Computer Doll No. 8... Knock it off, Keiko. I don't wanna remember that.
The ancient past, huh... Sounds interesting.
Oh, Akatsuki, are you an archaeology buff?
W-Well... a-actually, yes, I am.
Isn't it lovely, the romance of letting your mind wander to ancient times...
...That's way too transparent.
(The ones who wiped out the Gaizok people... were definitely them.
But why... the Campbellians...?)
Garuda... It's over. For now, anyway...
